description: LEGACY ADVISORY DIAGNOSTICS, NOT PLATFORM ACCEPTANCE: all flat thresholds below are owner hypothesis except max_influences, a computed ceiling from the official four-influence constraint. Named DD profiles: phone=compact, desktop=full; newly declared tablet=compact and console=full are owner hypotheses requiring explicit G0 targets; combinations use per-platform assignments and the declared common fallback. Other games use their own allocations. Pass only the selected whole-asset triangle ceiling through the documented budget_tris metadata; inspect other selected limits in the asset record. This unchanged flat schema does not implement automatic profile selection, per-mesh checks, runtime draws or device performance. Bytes use binary units; thresholds are inclusive.
threshold_semantics: value <= warn: ok; value <= over: warn; value > over: over; unknown: warn
